items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tricky Sam -- [INTERVIEWEE] Tricky Sam and those kind of people. That man has some of the greatest jazz musicians that I ever knew, and I knew them all, well, very well.

ctx.x: Blanton. He would have been with Duke. I don't know how Duke came about getting all great men like Jimmy Blanton, Otto Hardwick (unintelligible), Johnny Hodges, even Sonny Greer.

Tricky Sam and those kind of people. That man has some of the greatest jazz musicians that I ever knew, and I knew them all, well, very well. Back to Lips Page. I don't know whether Lips played with Duke. I know Basie played with him, and he played with Benny Morton. That's where Basie -- Basie was a piano player, and -- just a piano player in Benny Morton's band. He took over when Morton died. And then same one of the greatest swing bands in the land.]
